scheme_name: Non-Governmental Aided Organization (Special Schools And Vocational Training Centre) For Disabled
other_conditions: Must be a citizen of India
Must be a permanent resident of Maharashtra
Must be enrolled in a Non‑Government Institution/Residential Institution
Must be a person with disability having at least 40% disability (including visual, hearing, orthopaedic, etc.)
benefits_summary: Free special education for disabled children up to age 18 and free vocational training for disabled youth 18 years and above, with food, shelter and education provided in residential institutions.
